## Summary

[Partial] Apply Permatex 51813/51817 liquid gasket on back, bottom, and water inlet connections with paper gaskets at the block-to-housing interface. [t1682]

## Parts

- Liquid Gasket (Permatex 51813/51817) [t1682]

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Use paper gaskets for the block-to-housing interface where there is more surface area contact. [t1682]
